text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said on Monday its Business Information Products has expanded its Asian database of on-line news and information to more than 700 Asian sources.
A company statement said more than 200 sources had joined the service in the past few months.
Reuters now offers access to 164 full text Asian publications from Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Japan, Cambodia, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand, the statement said.

"By the year 2000, we aim to offer more of a comprehensive Asian database world-wide with thousands of Asian sources available on-line," it quoted Mark Trasenster, Managing Director of Reuters Business Information Products, Asia as saying.
Reuters had also signed contracts with several leading Asian publishers including Miller Freeman, Prospect Media and Nikon Mainichi Simbun-Sha.
Their publications would be available on the Reuters database in the next three months, the statement said.

Reuters Business Information Products, Asia, was established in 1994 and designed for corporate users. It enables business information to be retrieved from personal computers via dial-up or leased lines.
